chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"When the believer enters his grave, it is proclaimed: Lo! indeed, your first gift is Paradise; lo! and the first gift of those who followed you is forgiveness."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةُ: Paradise, the promised reward announced to the believer
key_terms.الْمَغْفِرَةُ: forgiveness, divine pardon granted to the followers
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer, the faithful person honored after death
key_terms.تَبِعَكَ: followed you, accompanied your funeral procession
key_terms.حِبَائِكَ: your gift, a bestowed divine favor
key_terms.قَبْرَهُ: his grave, the place entered after burial

ai.seo_question: What reward does a believer and those attending his funeral receive after death?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the honor granted to the mu'min at death and upon entering the grave, where the first divine gift announced for him is Jannah. It also highlights the mercy extended to those who accompany the deceased, as forgiveness is granted to those who followed his funeral procession.
